name: fluid-benchmarking
description:
Fluid Language Model Benchmarking



 
    
 
 
    
  
 
    
  
 
    This dataset provides IRT models for ARC Challenge, 
GSM8K, 
HellaSwag, 
MMLU, 
TruthfulQA, and 
WinoGrande. 
Furthermore, it contains 
results for pretraining checkpoints of Amber-6.7B, 
K2-65B, 
OLMo1-7B, 
OLMo2-7B, 
Pythia-2.8B, and
Pythia-6.9B, evaluated on these six benchmarks. 

	
		
		🚀 Usage
	

For utilities to use the dataset and to replicate the results from the paper, please see the corresponding GitHub… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/fluid-benchmarking.
typical_sota_score: varies widely by task (approx. 30–95% depending on the specific benchmark)
reputation: Used in research for item response theory (IRT)-based evaluation of language models and model calibration; referenced in model analysis work.
